incidents.name: MetaDragon unrestricted transform() minting
incidents.notes: MetaDragon's _transfer branch `if (to == address(this) || to == erc721) { transform(value); }` lets any caller mint by transferring to the token itself, which the attacker used to print and dump MetaDragon.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xEF1f39d8391cdDcaee62b8b383cB992F46a6ce4f created 2024-05-03T06:22:10Z by 0x27851617ac8fd50a8328a16f864912905c4cb4fb, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xc468d9a3a5557bff457586438c130e3afbec2ff9; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
